name: Power of the Bear
description: Spend a Secondary Action and 1 Soul to make a Will Check; each Success temporarily increases Strength (and everything it drives) up to twice its normal value.

name: Skin of the Armadillo
description: Spend a Primary and Secondary Action to make a Charisma Check; each Success raises Physical Defense, up to twice Charisma.

name: Warrior's Fire
description: Once per day, spend a Secondary Action and 2 Mind to fly into a rage, adding Critical Dice to Strength-based attacks each Round but forcing you to keep attacking until the rage is willfully broken with successive Will Checks.

name: Cougar's Grace
description: Spend a Secondary Action and 1 Mind to make a Wisdom Check; each Success temporarily increases Agility, up to twice its normal value.

name: Arrow's Wish
description: Spend a Secondary Action, 1 Soul, and 1 Mind to let dice showing 2-6 on your next Ranged Attack this Round be flipped to their higher opposing value before Focus or Legendary Ranks are applied.

name: Chameleon's Shine
description: Spend a Secondary Action and 1 Soul to roll twice your Spirit; the Successes make you far harder for organic vision to notice and add to your Physical Defense until you act against someone or the effect lapses.

name: Gecko's Heart
description: Spend Soul to boost Endurance Checks outside an Encounter, or spend a Secondary Action and 1 Soul during one to add Spirit to Endurance for its duration, at the cost of 1 Spirit until your next Long Rest.

name: River's Flow
description: Spend a Secondary Action and 1 Mind to add a die to a Physical or Mental Stat roll this Round, or to alter your own physiology for effects like accelerated healing, feigning death, or resisting recognition.

name: Winter's Rest
description: Spend a Secondary Action to fall into a death-like four-hour slumber that grants a Long Rest plus, on a Will and Spirit Check, extra recovery of Body, Mind, or Soul.

name: Eagle's Insight
description: Spend 1 Mind to substitute Intelligence for another Stat on a Skill Check outside an Encounter, or spend a Secondary Action and 1 Mind during one to study a foe and gain bonus dice against them next Round.

name: Wasp's Sting
description: Spend a Primary Action and 1 Mind to make a direct mental attack at Short or Medium Range; Successes against the target's Mental Defense drain their Mind and can Stun, knock Unconscious, or inflict lasting Stat loss.

name: Stone Thoughts
description: Spend Mind to passively wall off your mind from mental Abilities and social Skills, or spend 1 Mind as a Reaction Roll during an Encounter to add Intelligence plus Will Successes to your Mental Defense for the Round.

name: Hawk's Eye
description: Spend Soul to raise Perception up to double its normal value, one point per Soul spent; pushing Perception above 5 can unlock extraordinary senses but also risks being Stunned by overwhelming stimuli.

name: Raven's Call
description: Spend a Secondary Action and 1 Soul to make a Perception and Spirit Check linking your mind to another's for long-distance communication; Critical Successes can plant a subtle suggestion in the target's mind.

name: Quiet Mind
description: Enter a sustained meditative state to gain 1 Mind every ten minutes, up to your normal Mind plus twice your Charisma, keeping the bonus until spent, the next Encounter ends, or you take a Long Rest.

name: Read the Earth
description: Spend 2 Mind and enter a trance to make a Wisdom and Endurance Check; Successes determine how detailed an answer the Story Guide gives to a single question posed before the roll.

name: The Mother's Voice
description: Spend a Primary Action and 2 Mind to let a Charisma and Spirit Check (with three Critical Dice) take over an attempted action, with the Story Guide narrating the actual result achieved.

name: Far Sight
description: Spend a Primary Action and 2 Mind to make a Wisdom and Perception Check that lets you remotely see, hear, or otherwise sense a familiar place or person while your own body sits Stunned.

name: Walk The Black
description: Spend 1 Mind and 1 Soul outside an Encounter to make a Will Check that frees your consciousness to travel incorporeally through reality or into The Black while your body lies Unconscious.

name: Mender's Touch
description: Spend a Primary Action, 1 Mind, and 1 Soul, then spend further Soul and make a Spirit and Will Check to heal points of Body Damage on others you touch, at the risk of losing Soul on any Fails rolled.

name: Ancestor's Storm
description: Spend a Secondary Action, 1 Mind, and 1 Soul to make a Spirit and Charisma Check during an Encounter, distributing Successes as Mind or Soul to allies in sight.

name: Mountain's Inspiration
description: Spend a Primary and Secondary Action plus 1 Soul to make a Charisma Check; Successes are banked as bonus Successes on the next Check an ally makes with a Stat, Ability, or Skill you named.

name: Coyote's Gaze
description: Spend a Secondary Action and 2 Mind to make a Perception and Charisma Check against a target's Will-boosted Mental Defense, forging an unwilling empathic bond whose intensity scales with Successes.

name: Deer's Smile
description: Spend a Primary Action, 1 Mind, and 1 Soul to make a Charisma and Will Check that calms everyone within earshot, making violence difficult unless they beat your Successes with their own Will Check.

name: Wolverine's Resolve
description: Spend a Secondary Action and 1 Mind to become immune to Stun and Unconsciousness for the Encounter; each time you spend Soul on Fortitude, a Spirit and Endurance Reaction Roll refunds some of it, at a cost of 1 Spirit once the Encounter ends.

name: Spirit's Covenant
description: An always-on Ability that lets you discard your first Fail on any Check, while any 2 rolled specifically against you counts as a Fail instead.

name: Owl's Watch
description: Spend 1 Mind to stay immune to Surprise and gain bonus Initiative outside an Encounter, or spend a Secondary Action and 1 Mind during one to add Perception and Endurance to all Reaction Roll Dice Pools.
